description: Recolor the requested subject using one or more target colors.

fields.name: imageUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the product image. The image must be between 300 and 4096 pixels in both width and height.

fields.name: colors
fields.description: Target colors, from 1 to 25 entries. Each value must use full HEX (#RRGGBB), HSB (hsb(H, S%, B%)), or RGB (rgb(R, G, B)) format. Provide colors or refImageUrls, but not both.

fields.name: refImageUrls
fields.description: Reference image URLs for reference-image recoloring, from 1 to 25 entries. Provide refImageUrls or colors, but not both.
